checks_per_capture: Wrong SHA-256 is rejected before wire inspection.
A fixture SYN destination changed to 169.254.169.254 is rejected by the destination oracle even when its new SHA-256 is supplied.
A gzip compression-method byte changed from 8 to 9 is rejected by the offline decoder even when its new SHA-256 is supplied.
scope: Local mutations of retained fixture-namespace captures; no packets are sent to 169.254.169.254.
limitations: This validates three failure paths in the independent capture oracle. It does not rerun either native client or the Outbound Guard binary.
Mutated packets are test artifacts under a temporary directory, not real host-client or other-tool traffic.
The product rejects encoded responses before decompression; this does not establish safe accepted decompression.
Official-candidate gates and each AI Scraping Defense repository's separate adversarial gate remain open.
